source_checks.local_lab_launcher: Actual booted AVD/Appium/worker reuse; real backend health, device profile API and frontend HTTP 200

scope: Real controlled HTTPS targets, actual Chromium, APK, Appium, AVD and mitmproxy; no mocked product requests in acceptance harnesses
Positive impact acceptance: reflected and uploaded XSS; read-only BOLA with distinct authenticated identities and ownership control
All 13 categories issue real requests and preserve unproven/blocked/not-run states; this is not positive vulnerability-effect acceptance for every category
Unknown CA/hostname rejected, browser contexts isolated, Android untrusted upstream receives zero HTTP application requests; UI retry creates a new successful run and preserves the old failure
Model settings use a protocol fixture, not external model inference
Unit/integration suites include explicit device test doubles and are separate from real-device acceptance
runtime_source: Existing local tools and external disk Aegicove image; no further environment downloads after the user requested reuse
